sloka: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित् केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः ।अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन् हरियूथपाः ।। ६.४१.४७ ।।।।
transliteration: santi caughabalāḥ kecit kecicchataguṇottarāḥ ।aprameyabalāścānye tatrāsan hariyūthapāḥ ।। 6.41.47 ।।।।

translations.english: A few of them were having the strength of ten elephants, some had ten times more than others, and a few were endowed with great strength equal to thousand elephants.
